name: mcorucu SEO Tools
author: Mehmet Can Orucu

sections.description:
mcorucu SEO Tools gives site owners, editors, developers, and WooCommerce teams clear, explainable SEO guidance inside WordPress. Its deterministic analyzer reviews metadata, content structure, focus-keyword use, links, images, indexability, and schema readiness, then produces a repeatable 0-100 score with practical recommendations.

Editorial workflow

Work in Gutenberg or the Classic Editor with SEO title and meta description fields, focus-keyword guidance, search and social previews, canonical and robots controls, schema selection, and category-level recommendations. The score is rule-based and remains independent of optional AI suggestions.

Structured data and social metadata

Generate a Schema.org JSON-LD graph for site identity, pages, articles, breadcrumbs, and WooCommerce products. Open Graph and X/Twitter Card output includes configurable titles, descriptions, images, and identity fallbacks.

Technical SEO and maintenance

Use WordPress core XML Sitemap integration, robots.txt controls, technical health checks, duplicate-output visibility, and a frontend output inspector. The exact-match redirect manager and aggregated 404 monitor use plugin-owned tables; the monitor does not store visitor IP addresses.

WooCommerce and compatibility

Product checks cover images, alt text, short descriptions, SKU, taxonomy use, price, availability, reviews, and Product schema readiness. Commerce services run only when WooCommerce is active. The compatibility framework supports Gutenberg, the Classic Editor, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Avada.

Privacy-conscious optional AI

Core analysis, scoring, schema, social metadata, sitemaps, redirects, and deterministic suggestions run locally. AI is disabled by default, requires administrator opt-in and privacy acknowledgement, and runs only after an editor explicitly requests a suggestion. AI suggestions never alter the deterministic SEO score, and the plugin remains fully usable without AI.

Multilingual, extensible, and performance-conscious

WordPress selects bundled starter translations from the site locale. Developers can extend content adapters, scoring services, schema nodes, compatibility integrations, and AI providers through the REST API, hooks, and filters. Analysis is cached where appropriate, dashboard summaries use stored score data, and frontend output stays lean.

Highlights

  • Deterministic 0-100 SEO score with category-level recommendations.
  • Gutenberg sidebar and Classic Editor meta box.
  • Search preview, Open Graph preview, and X/Twitter Card support.
  • Schema.org JSON-LD graph with site identity and breadcrumbs.
  • WooCommerce product SEO checks and Product schema.
  • WordPress XML Sitemap and robots.txt controls.
  • Technical SEO health, output inspection, and conflict visibility.
  • Exact-match redirect manager and privacy-preserving 404 monitor.
  • REST API for editor analysis and suggestions.
  • Page-builder compatibility for Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Bricks, Beaver Builder, and Avada.
  • Optional provider-agnostic AI suggestions, disabled by default.
  • Multilingual translation infrastructure.
  • Site-wide Content Audit with filters, cached summaries, bulk recalculation, and CSV export.
  • Developer hooks, filters, and extensibility points.

External services

mcorucu SEO Tools works without external AI services. Deterministic analysis, SEO scoring, deterministic suggestions, schema, social metadata, XML sitemap support, redirects, and the 404 monitor run locally in WordPress.

Optional AI suggestions are available only when a site administrator explicitly enables AI, acknowledges the privacy notice, configures a provider/API key or local endpoint, and an editor clicks an AI suggestion action. AI suggestions are optional and do not affect SEO scoring. API keys are stored locally in the WordPress database in the AI settings option and are not included in normal settings export/import. mcorucu SEO Tools itself does not send AI data to the plugin author’s server.

When an AI action is requested, the configured provider may receive selected post, page, product, or custom post type content; SEO title; meta description; focus keyword; excerpt; title; slug; schema/social context; and the selected suggestion request, such as title, description, keyword, headings, FAQ, schema, or content improvement.

OpenAI

Used for optional AI suggestions such as SEO title, meta description, keywords, headings, FAQ, schema, or content improvement. Data is sent only when AI is enabled/configured and an editor requests an AI suggestion.

Endpoint:
https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions

Terms:
https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use

Privacy:
https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Anthropic Claude

Used for optional AI suggestions such as SEO title, meta description, keywords, headings, FAQ, schema, or content improvement. Data is sent only when AI is enabled/configured and an editor requests an AI suggestion.

Endpoint:
https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages

Terms:
https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms

Privacy:
https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Google Gemini

Used for optional AI suggestions such as SEO title, meta description, keywords, headings, FAQ, schema, or content improvement. Data is sent only when AI is enabled/configured and an editor requests an AI suggestion.

Endpoint:
https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/

Terms:
https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

OpenRouter

Used for optional AI suggestions through OpenRouter-compatible chat completions. Data is sent only when AI is enabled/configured and an editor requests an AI suggestion.

Endpoint:
https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions

Terms:
https://openrouter.ai/terms

Privacy:
https://openrouter.ai/privacy

Ollama

Ollama is supported as a local or self-hosted provider. The plugin connects only to the endpoint configured by the site administrator, usually a local or self-hosted Ollama endpoint. Terms and privacy obligations depend on the administrator’s own deployment.

Website:
https://ollama.com/

Custom REST / LM Studio-compatible endpoint

Custom REST connects only to the endpoint URL configured by the site administrator. It can be used with LM Studio-compatible local workflows or other compatible services. There is no default third-party endpoint for Custom REST. Terms and privacy obligations depend on the configured service.

WordPress AI Client note

mcorucu SEO Tools currently supports direct optional provider connections. If the WordPress AI Client is available and stable in the target WordPress environment, mcorucu SEO Tools may add support for it in a future release so site owners can use centrally configured AI providers. The plugin does not claim WordPress AI Client support in this version.

Developer Reference

mcorucu SEO Tools exposes actions and filters for services, scoring rules, content adapters, schema graph nodes, compatibility integrations, AI providers, AI suggestions, and stop words.

Developer documentation:
https://docs.mcorucu.com/mcorucu-seo-tools/

Source repository:
https://github.com/mcorucu/mcorucu-seo-tools
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mcorucu-seo-tools folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate mcorucu SEO Tools from Plugins in WordPress admin.
  3. Open mcorucu SEO Tools > Settings to review editor, output, redirect, commerce, and optional AI settings.
  4. Use the optional setup guide after activation, or reopen it from Dashboard or Settings.
  5. Edit a post, page, product, or supported custom post type to view SEO guidance.
  6. Save content to persist cached SEO scores.
sections.faq:
Does mcorucu SEO Tools send my content to external services?

No, not by default. The analyzer, score engine, deterministic suggestions, schema, sitemap, redirects, and 404 monitor are local. Optional AI suggestions require administrator opt-in, privacy acknowledgement, and an explicit editor action.

Does AI change the SEO score?

No. AI only returns suggestions. The deterministic analyzer remains the source of truth for the SEO score.

Can mcorucu SEO Tools be used without AI?

Yes. mcorucu SEO Tools is fully usable without AI. AI is optional, disabled by default, and separate from deterministic scoring.

Does mcorucu SEO Tools support WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce-specific product analysis and Product schema are gated and run only when WooCommerce is active.

Does mcorucu SEO Tools support page builders?

Yes. The compatibility framework supports Gutenberg, Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Avada, and the Classic Editor.

Does mcorucu SEO Tools replace other SEO plugins automatically?

No. It detects common SEO plugins and surfaces compatibility information, but it does not disable other plugins or silently migrate data.

Are redirects stored in post meta?

No. Redirects and 404 logs use plugin-owned custom tables with the mcorucu_seo_tools_ prefix. 404 logs aggregate request paths and do not store IP addresses.

What happens on uninstall?

Data is kept by default. If the owner enables data removal before uninstalling, mcorucu SEO Tools removes its options, post meta, transients, capability, and custom redirect/log tables.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2

  • Refreshed WordPress.org icons and banners with a clean mcSEO visual identity.
  • Improved the public description and launch copy.
  • Synchronized WordPress.org, documentation, project, and GitHub links.
  • Completed post-approval release polish without changing core features or deterministic scoring.

1.2.1

  • Fixed WordPress.org review issues related to dynamic Ajax path generation, early sanitization of server input, and prefix consistency.
  • Improved review compliance while preserving plugin behavior.

1.2.0

  • Completed the public rebrand to mcorucu SEO Tools for the WordPress.org-assigned slug mcorucu-seo-tools.
  • Updated plugin metadata, text domain, documentation links, GitHub links, support links, and release assets.
  • Regenerated screenshots, icons, banners, documentation images, social images, and translation metadata.
  • Preserved deterministic scoring, SEO output, AI privacy behavior, WooCommerce support, redirects, and compatibility behavior.

1.1.4

  • Fixed remaining Plugin Check compliance issues.
  • Improved custom table SQL annotations and safety.
  • Added multilingual translation infrastructure.
  • Added optional first-run setup guide.
  • Updated public WordPress.org metadata and release packaging.

1.1.2

  • Prepared WordPress.org preflight release package and synchronized version metadata.
  • Updated screenshot captions for the complete ten-image WordPress.org asset set.
  • No feature changes.

1.0.0-RC1

  • First public release candidate.
  • Added deterministic SEO score engine, editor UI, schema/social output, sitemap/robots tools, compatibility framework, WooCommerce support, redirects, SEO tools, and optional AI suggestion framework.
  • Added release documentation, translation template, demo dataset, and packaging checklist.
